# My Agent

parses dungeons and dragons books in pdf format, then indexes the data for quick access to respond to prompts for DnD content

Uses data learned from official rulebooks and adventure guides to Generate Monsters, NPC's, maps with accompanying images, character sheets, settings and locations, all with detailed descriptions
